simple.meaning: רָגַל (râgal) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to walk along ; but only in specifically, applications, to reconnoiter , to be a tale-bearer (i.e. slander); to lead about.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 25 times across Genesis, Numbers, Deuteronomy, Joshua, Judges, and 4 more, beginning at Genesis 42:9. Its contexts include family, family line, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to רָגַל (H7270).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: רָגַל (râgal) / H7270 is traced through Genesis 42:9, Genesis 42:11, Genesis 42:14, Genesis 42:16 as a generated source-based concept entry.
